name: io.github.seanhanca/glyph
description: Deterministic chart compiler with 53 agent-callable verbs. Render JSON specs to byte-stable SVG (24 mark types), query the underlying DuckDB view, audit charts (16 rules) for misleading patterns, refine specs through an audit-aware glyph_spec_patch that refuses regressions, seal provenance with glyph_seal (SHA-256 over spec+rows+schema), forecast and detect anomalies, decompose time series, and build cross-agent analytic narratives (Whyboard + Story templates) — all via one MCP server. 1,022 tests.
